scope: ET6 native acceptance evidence during immediate cancellation
defect: Controller retained a one-shot successor acceptance measurement for subsequent events, including immediate cancellation.
repair: Capture the acceptance in its original event and remove it from retained measurements before invoking the event listener, including synchronous cancellation callbacks.

native_test.cases: Immediate and reentrant cancellation preserve exactly one acceptance, release controls, and perform no successor pulse. Existing three-window handoff regressions also pass.

limitations: Native bridge fixture, not packaged Minecraft live acceptance.
No HTTP reconnect or lost-delivery proof yet.
Existing keyed-server Casimir gate is not proof that this native patch is deployed.
